title: Mr C Residences hero
description: A sticky full-bleed video hero, as tall as the window on desktop, with one centred uppercase line (light words, then the name in bold), a thin white outline button that fills white on hover, and a small 'scroll' cue with a chevron at the bottom. The hero stays pinned while the rest of the page slides up over it; as it goes, the copy fades out, the black tint deepens from 30% to 80% and the content drifts slowly upward.
notes: it is sticky: put it first on the page, and give the sections after it position relative (all this site's blocks are) so they slide over it
the scroll effects follow the page's own scroll (scroll(root)), from the top of the page
phones: 390:429 under a 62px fixed header bar (mrcresidencesbocaraton-header); from 1024px: 101svh
white text over media in both modes; empty media is the primary colour under the tint
